title: Declare chat crates' 0.4 API stable in docs
description: Freeze blocker from the fifth 2026-10-21 freeze review. JMAP-lrgt acceptance criteria require 'CHANGELOG and crate docs declare the 0.4 API stable for the chat crates'; no bead tracks it. At HEAD 860a4c2a: crate-jmap-chat-{types,server,client}/README.md L3-5 still say 'Pre-stable (0.3.x) ... Expect breaking changes, especially new required ChatBackend methods, until the 0.4 API freeze'; CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] (L13) has no stability statement; Cargo.toml versions are 0.3.0. Update the three README banners and crate-level docs, add a CHANGELOG note stating the 0.4 stability promise (what semver covers: ChatBackend required methods, pub types; additive seams), against jmap-chat-spec 33702a5. Do last, after lrgt.9/lrgt.10 children close and JMAP-kgx2 is decided.
